result: Core release/fix claims verified; material SKOPOS dashboard trusted-proxy claim is false with supported Streamlit 1.66.1.

material_finding.cause: _websocket_peer reads client.request.remote_ip. Streamlit 1.66.1 uses StarletteSessionClient.client_context.remote_ip and has no request attribute. Normal supported client therefore takes the untrusted-header fallback.
material_finding.impact: At direct dashboard access, or through a proxy that preserves attacker headers, an attacker controls the per-IP login-lockout key. Rotating headers switches buckets; a known successful IP receives the global pacing exemption. Existing valid remember-me cookies and unknown-IP global pacing remain.
material_finding.scope_limit: Component-level reproduction with real published Streamlit client and unchanged SKOPOS functions; no network end-to-end or live deployment test. Does not by itself invalidate all nine fixes.
material_finding.recommendation: Read the supported remote_ip API and fail closed when peer cannot be resolved; do not accept client address headers without verifying proxy trust. Verify new behavior before claiming complete SKOPOS proxy enforcement.
